title: Gamdom
description:
Gamdom is an unregulated crypto casino and sportsbook founded in 2016. It recently suffered a hot-wallet breach, with founder Felix Romer reporting over $3 million in losses, though on-chain analysts estimate the damage closer to $4.2 million.

We hold Gamdom's full user database, 15,420,003 accounts with 146 columns, with Gamdom's total combined profit value exceeding $1 billion.

The way in was something internal, a machine account that was already sitting in their admin side (Metawin). 
Issued years back, nobody ever rotated it. Never meant to leave the building. 
It had admin reach, and everything after that was their own stuff anyway, their control panels and secret stores.

About your provably fair: what it promised and what it delivered were never the same thing.

We demand $15,000,000 in BTC.

Emails with instructions will be sent to you directly.
